target_customer: Gamers who use a rewards card for everyday spending
problem: Gamers want rewards such as consoles and headsets from spending, but standard card rewards do not target them.
business_model: Consumer rewards card with random rewards per swipe, funded by card interchange

founders.name: Derek Pankaew
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Derek (Pankaew) Wild. His bio there says he moved to crypto analytics and later Listening.com.

founders.name: Eric Lafleche
founders.background_notes: YC page says he now works on Listening.com. No other background listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: A card program needs a bank or issuing partner and compliance work, though the app side was standard engineering.

defensibility.rationale: A rewards layer on a card program had no unique technology or data and was copyable by any issuer.

market_need_then: CB Insights describes rewards such as free PS5s, Xboxes and VR headsets for swipes. No dated demand evidence was found.

brand_strength.rationale: No site, press or community found. Search results confuse it with Mythic and Mythos companies.

pivots.why: A founder profile describes the path from rewards card to crypto analytics; no date or reason given.

outcome_analysis: Mythia was a Winter 2021 gamer rewards card that, per a founder profile, moved into crypto analytics, and both founders now work on Listening.com. YC marks it Inactive, but no shutdown notice, acquisition or post-mortem was found, so the cause is not public and no failure factors are assigned. Funding is a single database figure of about 130 thousand dollars, against a founder claim of 2.2 million raised and 500 thousand in revenue that cannot be verified or tied to this company.
notes: No website is listed on the YC page, so there was no site to fetch. The 130K seed rests on a single database (CB Insights); the founder profile on the YC page claims about 2.2M raised and over 500K revenue, which conflicts and may include later ventures. Founding year is 2018 per YC and 2020 per CB Insights. No competitor with a dated source was found, so the list is empty.
